ai_summary: A sophisticated dark-themed hero section featuring smooth scrolling via ReactLenis, parallax imagery with clip-path morphing effects, and gradient overlays. The component includes a fixed navigation bar, animated center imagery that scales and clips on scroll, and floating parallax elements. Built with Framer Motion for smooth transitions, it creates an immersive cinematic experience ideal for tech and space-themed landing pages.
